name: A Tale of a Meeting
source:
A young empress must secure peace with a kingdom twice her size, or face total annihilation at the cost of her mistakes.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=45&t=21531]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
一位年轻的皇后必须与一个面积是她两倍的王国保持和平，否则她将因自己的错误而面临彻底的毁灭。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=45&t=21531]引理软论坛[/url]]
